introduction: The nightshift `--audit` flag enables full audit logging for daemon runs, wiring `AgentTraceSink` and `AuditJsonlSink` into the `SinkDispatcher` and emitting two new structured audit event types (`spec.inmemory_created` and `spec.afspec_created`) that serialize in-memory spec objects built during the fix pipeline.

glossary.AgentTraceSink: An afaudit sink that writes model conversation traces (system prompt, task prompt, assistant messages, tool calls) to a per-run JSONL file under `.agent-fox/audit/`
glossary.AuditEventType: A StrEnum in `afaudit.events` enumerating all recognized audit event type strings
glossary.AuditJsonlSink: An afaudit sink that writes structured audit events to a per-run JSONL file under `.agent-fox/audit/`
glossary.DuckDBSink: The default afaudit sink that writes events to a DuckDB database; always present in the dispatcher regardless of `--audit`
glossary.FixPipeline: The nightshift class that orchestrates the per-issue fix workflow, including spec building, coding, and review steps
glossary.InMemorySpec: A lightweight in-memory representation of a spec built from a GitHub issue, constructed by `build_in_memory_spec(issue, issue_body)`
glossary.SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED: The new `AuditEventType` enum value `spec.afspec_created` emitted after `build_afspec_from_triage()` succeeds
glossary.SPEC_INMEMORY_CREATED: The new `AuditEventType` enum value `spec.inmemory_created` emitted after `build_in_memory_spec()` succeeds
glossary.SinkDispatcher: The afaudit multiplexer that fans out session events to all registered sinks
glossary.Spec: The rich afspec Pydantic model (`afspec.models.Spec`) built from triage output via `build_afspec_from_triage`, containing `requirements`, `test_spec`, `tasks`, and `prd` fields
glossary._assemble_afspec_context: The `FixPipeline` method that calls `build_afspec_from_triage` and assembles context for the coder and reviewer prompts
glossary._run_daemon: The internal nightshift function in `nightshift/app.py` that initializes all subsystems and starts the engine loop
glossary.audit_run_id: The string key in `ctx.obj` that holds the run identifier when `--audit` is active; empty string when `--audit` is not set
glossary.build_afspec_from_triage: A nightshift function that constructs an afspec `Spec` from triage output and an issue number
glossary.build_in_memory_spec: A nightshift function that constructs an `InMemorySpec` from a GitHub issue and its body text
glossary.ctx.obj: The Click context object dictionary (`dict`) used to pass state between CLI commands and subcommands in nightshift
glossary.emit_audit_event: The afaudit function `emit_audit_event(sink, run_id, event_type, *, payload) -> None` that writes a single structured event to the dispatcher
glossary.generate_run_id: The afaudit function `generate_run_id() -> str` that produces a unique identifier for a daemon run
glossary.init_knowledge: The nightshift startup function in `nightshift/_startup.py` that returns `(kdb, sink, kprov)` where `sink` is a `SinkDispatcher`
glossary.process_issue: The `FixPipeline` method that processes a single GitHub issue through the full fix pipeline, accepting an optional `run_id` parameter
glossary.render_combined: The afspec function `render_combined(spec: Spec, *, max_tokens: int | None = None) -> str` that renders a full spec as a markdown string
glossary.session.init: The audit event type emitted by `AgentTraceSink` at the start of a model session, containing `system_prompt` and `task_prompt` fields
glossary.--audit: The Click boolean flag added to the nightshift CLI command that enables full audit logging; is_flag=True, default=False
glossary.generate_run_id(): The afaudit function that generates a unique run identifier string used for naming audit JSONL files and correlating events
glossary.agent_{run_id}.jsonl: The per-run conversation trace file written by AgentTraceSink to AUDIT_DIR, containing session.init, tool.use, assistant.message, and session.result events
glossary.audit_{run_id}.jsonl: The per-run structured audit event file written by AuditJsonlSink to AUDIT_DIR, containing events like spec.inmemory_created and spec.afspec_created

requirements.title: Zero overhead when --audit is not set

user_story.goal: run nightshift in production without any audit overhead unless I explicitly pass --audit
user_story.benefit: I avoid performance impact and accumulation of large JSONL files on production systems

correctness_properties.title: Audit files created iff --audit is set
correctness_properties.invariant: files matching `agent_*.jsonl` or `audit_*.jsonl` exist in `.agent-fox/audit/` if and only if `--audit` was passed to the CLI for that run

correctness_properties.title: DuckDBSink always present regardless of --audit
correctness_properties.invariant: `DuckDBSink` is always present in the `SinkDispatcher`'s sink list, whether or not `--audit` is set

correctness_properties.title: SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED emitted only on successful build

correctness_properties.invariant: no `spec.afspec_created` event appears in `audit_{run_id}.jsonl` for that issue

correctness_properties.title: AuditEventType enum values are additive and non-conflicting
correctness_properties.invariant: `AuditEventType.SPEC_INMEMORY_CREATED == 'spec.inmemory_created'` and `AuditEventType.SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED == 'spec.afspec_created'` and all pre-existing enum members retain their original string values

execution_paths.title: Happy path: --audit run with InMemorySpec and Spec events

steps.action: invokes `nightshift run --audit` from the command line
calls `generate_run_id()` to produce a unique `run_id`, stores it in `ctx.obj['audit_run_id']`, and passes `audit=True` and `run_id` into `_run_daemon`
calls `init_knowledge()` to obtain `(kdb, sink, kprov)` where `sink` is a `SinkDispatcher` containing `DuckDBSink`
instantiates `AgentTraceSink(AUDIT_DIR, run_id)` and `AuditJsonlSink(AUDIT_DIR, run_id)`, then calls `SinkDispatcher.add` for each
starts `NightShiftEngine` with the augmented dispatcher and passes `run_id` through to `FixPipeline`
calls `process_issue(issue, run_id=run_id)`, which calls `build_in_memory_spec(issue, issue_body)` to produce an `InMemorySpec`
calls `emit_audit_event(sink, run_id, AuditEventType.SPEC_INMEMORY_CREATED, payload={issue_number, title, branch_name, task_prompt, system_context[:10000]})` wrapped in try/except
appends the `spec.inmemory_created` event as a JSON line to `.agent-fox/audit/audit_{run_id}.jsonl`
calls `_assemble_afspec_context()`, which calls `build_afspec_from_triage(triage, issue_number)` to produce a `Spec`

calls `render_combined(spec)`, truncates to 50 000 chars, then calls `emit_audit_event(sink, run_id, AuditEventType.SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED, payload={issue_number, spec_id, requirements_count, test_cases_count, subtasks_count, rendered})` wrapped in try/except
appends the `spec.afspec_created` event as a JSON line to `.agent-fox/audit/audit_{run_id}.jsonl`
writes model conversation events including `session.init` to `.agent-fox/audit/agent_{run_id}.jsonl`

execution_paths.title: No-audit path: daemon run without --audit flag

steps.action: invokes `nightshift run` without `--audit`
sets `ctx.obj['audit_run_id']` to an empty string and passes `audit=False` into `_run_daemon`
calls `init_knowledge()` to obtain the default `SinkDispatcher` containing only `DuckDBSink`; skips all audit sink instantiation
starts with the default dispatcher; `FixPipeline.process_issue()` is called with `run_id=''`
detects empty `run_id`, skips all `emit_audit_event` calls for `SPEC_INMEMORY_CREATED` and `SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED`
no `agent_*.jsonl` or `audit_*.jsonl` files are created in `.agent-fox/audit/`
invokes `nightshift run --audit` on a system where `.agent-fox/audit/` is not writable
calls `generate_run_id()`, stores `run_id` in `ctx.obj['audit_run_id']`, passes `audit=True` into `_run_daemon`
attempts to instantiate `AgentTraceSink(AUDIT_DIR, run_id)` or create `AUDIT_DIR`; catches the permissions or IO exception
logs a WARNING-level message describing the unwritable directory and skips attaching audit sinks
starts `NightShiftEngine` with the default `SinkDispatcher` containing only `DuckDBSink`
completes the run normally with exit code 0; no audit JSONL files are created

error_handling.condition: `AUDIT_DIR` is not writable or does not exist and cannot be created when `--audit` is set
error_handling.behavior: log a WARNING-level message and continue daemon startup without attaching `AgentTraceSink` or `AuditJsonlSink`; daemon exits with code 0

error_handling.condition: `AgentTraceSink` or `AuditJsonlSink` constructor raises an exception other than a permissions error
error_handling.behavior: log a WARNING-level message with exception details, skip the failing sink, and continue daemon startup with the remaining sinks

error_handling.condition: `emit_audit_event` raises any exception when emitting `SPEC_INMEMORY_CREATED` in `process_issue()`
error_handling.behavior: catch the exception, log at DEBUG level, and continue issue processing without re-raising

error_handling.condition: `emit_audit_event` raises any exception when emitting `SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED` in `_assemble_afspec_context()`
error_handling.behavior: catch the exception, log at DEBUG level, and continue context assembly without re-raising

error_handling.condition: `render_combined(spec)` raises an exception inside the best-effort emit wrapper
error_handling.behavior: catch the exception within the try/except wrapper, log at DEBUG level, skip the `SPEC_AFSPEC_CREATED` emit, and continue `_assemble_afspec_context()` normally

error_handling.condition: `generate_run_id()` raises an exception during CLI startup with `--audit`
error_handling.behavior: propagate the exception; the daemon does not start and exits with a non-zero exit code

error_handling.condition: the `agent_{run_id}.jsonl` file cannot be written mid-run (e.g. disk full)
error_handling.behavior: `AgentTraceSink` logs the write failure at WARNING level and continues; the daemon does not crash

error_handling.condition: `run_id` passed to `FixPipeline.process_issue()` is an empty string (audit disabled)
error_handling.behavior: all `emit_audit_event` call sites treat empty `run_id` as audit-disabled and skip emission without raising exceptions
